results.canonical_news_title: Canadian and French publishers stand by author accused of using AI for prize-winning novel
competition_search_terms: publisher AI authorship allegation evidence case workflow
literary prize AI authorship review software
Türkiye yayıncı AI yazarlık inceleme yazılımı
results.market_gap: AI detectors/plagiarism tools exist, but fresh search did not verify a direct product for publishers/award panels that assembles declaration, version history, detector outputs, human review and appeal into one defensible case.
results.mvp: Case intake, declarations, evidence/version attachments, detector-result registry, reviewer decision, appeal pack.
results.working_logic: Claim → evidence intake → conflicting signals → reviewer notes → decision → appeal/export.
results.marketing_strategy: publishers, literary prizes, academic/editorial integrity teams
results.first_customer_plan: small publisher or award organizer with written AI policy
results.main_risk: Low case frequency; adjacent plagiarism/detection products may add workflow.
results.validation_assumption: Customers need defensible human-review case management rather than another detector.

results.canonical_news_title: Electric trucks are cheaper to operate than diesel in most markets
competition_search_terms: electric truck fleet TCO route electrification planning software
fleet replacement electrification scenario tool truck
Türkiye elektrikli kamyon filo TCO rota fizibilite
results.market_gap: Fresh search did not verify a direct lightweight product matching small/mid-size road fleets + vehicle/route prioritization + payback sensitivity/replacement queue; broader fleet electrification consultancies/tools remain adjacent.
results.mvp: Fleet import, route duty assumptions, diesel-vs-EV TCO, charging assumptions, sensitivity, replacement queue.
results.working_logic: Truck/route → duty cycle → energy/charging/capex assumptions → TCO/payback → sensitivity → prioritized replacement queue.
results.lovable_credit_breakdown: fleet model 70; TCO engine 100; scenarios 80; queue 70; QA 70
results.marketing_strategy: small fleets, leasing firms, EV truck dealers
results.main_risk: Accurate local electricity, charging and residual-value assumptions.
results.validation_assumption: Manual configurable assumptions are sufficient for MVP without paid data APIs.
results.rejection_reason: The development is credible and MVP feasible, but competitor search was not conclusive enough to assert a direct-market gap.

global_competitors.name: Bubba
global_competitors.reason: Carrier-side AI negotiates broker offers within carrier constraints and can seek approval before confirmation.

global_competitors.name: Dispatchino
global_competitors.reason: Carrier/fleet AI dispatcher negotiates broker rates, asks for approval when needed and keeps conversations in one dashboard.

global_competitors.name: Keptline
global_competitors.reason: Negotiation workspace with target/ceiling, drafts, review/approval and per-lane conversation history.

adjacent_competitors.name: LoadGate
adjacent_competitors.reason: AI freight procurement/negotiation primarily shipper/broker procurement side.

competition_search_terms: AI freight negotiation carrier approval dashboard
AI dispatcher broker rate negotiation approval
results.market_gap: The carrier-side negotiation/approval workflow is already directly productized.
results.mvp: Negotiation inbox, normalized offers, guardrails, approval, booking ledger.
results.working_logic: Load → broker conversations → normalized offers → guardrail → human approval → booking evidence.
results.validation_assumption: No defensible novelty against current products.
results.rejection_reason: Bubba, Dispatchino and Keptline substantially match AI load negotiation, guardrails, approval and conversation/booking workflow.

competition_search_terms: AI agent permission policy builder least privilege
agent job to permission policy generator
Türkiye AI agent izin politika oluşturucu
results.market_gap: Core guided permission-policy job is already directly available globally.
results.mvp: Job wizard, tool/data matrix, risk/autonomy rules, policy export, evidence log.
results.working_logic: Agent job → tools/data → risk → least privilege matrix → policy → review/export.
results.main_risk: Free direct tools and platform-native controls.
results.rejection_reason: Agent Permission Builder directly performs guided least-privilege policy generation; Allowix further overlaps runtime governance.

lightweight product genealogy NCR inspection software

results.market_gap: MES/QMS traceability products are common, but fresh search did not conclusively verify a direct CSV-first lightweight genealogy + inspection/NCR ledger aimed specifically at SMEs without MES.
results.mvp: CSV/manual ingest, lot/unit genealogy, inspection links, NCR links, alerts, trend board.
results.working_logic: Import unit/lot/process records → build genealogy → attach inspections/NCR → exceptions → trace/history export.
results.lovable_credit_breakdown: ingest 100; genealogy 120; quality links 90; alerts/dashboard 90; QA 70
results.first_customer_plan: manufacturer currently using spreadsheets for lot traceability
results.main_risk: Existing MES/QMS vendors may qualify as direct after deeper product-level verification.
results.validation_assumption: CSV-first/no-MES positioning creates a distinct workflow/segment.
results.rejection_reason: MVP is feasible, but direct-vs-adjacent competition among MES/QMS genealogy products remains insufficiently verified.
